agave.look: an AGAVE: a large rosette of thick spiky grey-green succulent leaves spreading out low.

aloe.look: an ALOE: a rosette of thick pointed blue-green succulent leaves with toothed edges.

bramble.look: a BRAMBLE: a tangled thorny shrub with dark green leaves and a few blackberries.

broken_net.look: a BROKEN handheld bug net lying on the ground, seen from above: a wooden HANDLE with a round hoop at the end holding torn, frayed mesh full of holes. A damaged catching net.

bush.look: a small round leafy BUSH: a compact mound of green foliage in rounded clusters, lighter on top, darker at the base. No trunk.

bush_flowering.look: a FLOWERING BUSH: a rounded green shrub dotted with small white-and-pink blossoms.

cattail.look: CATTAILS: tall narrow reed blades with one or two brown cylindrical seed-heads on stalks.

chamomile.look: a small CHAMOMILE plant: a slender green stem with feathery leaves topped by one or two little white DAISY flowers with yellow centers.

clover.look: a patch of CLOVER: low rounded trefoil green leaves with a couple of small round white-pink clover flower heads.

clubmoss.look: CLUBMOSS: a low creeping mat of tiny scale-leaved green stems.

compost_pile.look: a low mound of dark COMPOST — rotting brown leaves, vegetable scraps and dark crumbly soil heaped up; NOT a dirt block, NOT a bush

dandelion.look: a DANDELION: a low rosette of jagged green leaves with one bright yellow flower and one round white seed PUFF on slender stems.

duckweed.look: DUCKWEED: a flat scatter of tiny round green leaves covering the water surface.

fallen_fruit.look: two or three small round red APPLES lying on the ground, seen from directly above, ripe and whole. Just apples — red.

fallen_orange.look: two or three small round ORANGES lying on the ground, seen from directly above, ripe and whole. Just oranges — orange.

fennel.look: FENNEL: a tall stalk with feathery green fronds and a flat yellow flower umbel on top.

fern.look: a FERN: a clump of arching green FRONDS with feathery divided leaflets spreading up and out from the base. No flowers.

flower_aster.look: an ASTER: a slender stem topped by a daisy-like flower with many thin purple petals around a yellow center.

flower_blue.look: a small flowering plant: a short green stem with little leaves and one or two bright BLUE blossoms with a yellow center.

flower_bluebell.look: BLUEBELLS: an arching stem with several drooping blue bell-shaped flowers.

flower_foxglove.look: a FOXGLOVE: a tall spike hung with many tubular pink-purple bell flowers, broad leaves at the base.

flower_red.look: a small flowering plant: a short green stem with little leaves and one or two bright RED blossoms with a yellow center.

flower_yellow.look: a small flowering plant: a short green stem with little leaves and one or two bright YELLOW blossoms with a darker center.

grapevine.look: a GRAPEVINE: a leafy vine with broad lobed leaves and a hanging cluster of purple grapes.

ivy.look: IVY: a creeping vine of dark green lobed leaves trailing along the ground/wall.

lavender.look: a LAVENDER plant: a small bushy clump of narrow grey-green leaves with several upright spikes of tiny PURPLE flowers.

log_pile.look: a neat STACK OF CUT LOGS — pale round cut ends facing the viewer, brown bark, stacked low; NOT a single log, NOT a fence

milkweed.look: a MILKWEED plant: a tall upright green stem with broad paired leaves topped by a rounded CLUSTER of small pink-mauve flowers.

mint.look: a MINT herb: a low leafy clump of bright green serrated paired leaves on square stems.

morning_glory.look: MORNING GLORY: a climbing vine with heart leaves and trumpet-shaped blue-purple flowers.

moss_clump.look: a MOSS CLUMP: a soft low cushion of velvety green moss on the ground.

mushroom_blue.look: a glowing BLUE cave mushroom cluster: several slender mushrooms with luminous cyan-blue caps casting a soft glow, on pale stems.

mushroom_bracket.look: a BRACKET / shelf fungus: stacked half-round woody shelves banded brown and cream, as if growing from a surface.

mushroom_brown.look: a small brown MUSHROOM: a single round domed brown cap on a short pale stem. Simple woodland mushroom.

mushroom_chanterelle.look: a golden CHANTERELLE mushroom: a funnel-shaped wavy-edged golden-yellow cap on a tapering pale stem.

mushroom_cluster.look: a CLUSTER of tiny tan mushrooms: a dense little group of small round-capped mushrooms of varying height on a mossy base.

mushroom_inkcap.look: an INKCAP mushroom: a tall thin shaggy white-grey bell-shaped cap on a slender stalk, edges darkening to ink.

mushroom_morel.look: a MOREL mushroom: a tall conical honeycomb-textured tan cap (pitted and netted) on a pale hollow stalk.

mushroom_puffball.look: a round white PUFFBALL mushroom: a smooth ball-shaped cream-white fungus low on the ground, with soft GREY shading on its underside and a thin darker grey OUTLINE so it reads clearly on a transparent background. A short stubby base.

pampas.look: PAMPAS GRASS: a big fountain of arching grass blades topped with fluffy cream plumes.

pondweed.look: PONDWEED: wispy submerged green strands and small floating leaves.

poppy.look: a POPPY: a slender green stem topped by a single cup-shaped bright RED flower with a dark center, and one nodding bud.

rotten_fruit.look: a piece of ROTTING FRUIT on the ground seen from above: brown, mushy and partly collapsed with dark spots and a faint haze — clearly spoiled (a fly attractant).

sage.look: a SAGE herb: a small woody clump of soft grey-green oval leaves, a few purple flower spikes.

stump.look: a low TREE STUMP — a flat round cut top showing growth RINGS, short bark sides, a couple roots at the base; NOT a full tree, NOT a log

sunflower.look: a tall SUNFLOWER: an upright green stem with a couple of leaves, topped by a big round flower head of bright YELLOW petals around a dark brown center.

tall_grass.look: a tuft of TALL GRASS: a clump of upright thin green grass blades fanning out, wild, denser at the base. Just grass blades, no flowers.

thyme.look: a THYME herb: a low spreading mat of tiny green leaves with faint pink flowers.

tree_apple.look: an APPLE TREE: a brown trunk and a round green leafy canopy dotted with small RED APPLES peeking through the leaves.

tree_oak.look: a leafy OAK TREE: a thick brown TRUNK at the bottom widening into a big round, full CANOPY of green leaves in rounded bumpy clusters, lighter green highlights on top, darker green underneath. Lush and full.

tree_pine.look: a PINE / EVERGREEN tree: a tall layered CONICAL stack of dark-green needled branches tapering to a point at the top, with a short brown trunk at the base.

water_lily.look: a WATER LILY: round flat green pads floating with a single white-pink open flower.

wild_berry_bush.look: a small BERRY BUSH: a low rounded leafy green shrub dotted with clusters of small red BERRIES.

yarrow.look: a YARROW plant: a slim stem with feathery leaves topped by a flat CLUSTER of tiny white flowers.

milkweed_giant.look: an OVERSIZED MILKWEED clump: several tall thick green stems with broad paired leaves, topped by big rounded CLUSTERS of pink-mauve flowers; lush and showy, much larger than a single milkweed.

clover_red.look: a low RED CLOVER patch: trefoil leaves with deep pink-magenta rounded globe flower heads on short stems.

stump_mossy.look: a low TREE STUMP furred over with green MOSS on top and sides, a couple small toadstools at its base; cut rings barely visible under the moss. NOT a full tree.

log_fallen.look: a long single FALLEN TREE TRUNK lying horizontally on the ground, brown bark, one pale cut end, patches of green moss and a few bracket mushrooms along the top. NOT a stack of logs, NOT standing.

marsh_plant.look: a clump of tall MARSH CATTAILS — slim green reed leaves with two or three brown sausage-shaped seed heads on thin upright stalks; waterside bulrushes

wasp_nest.look: a grey papery WASP NEST: a teardrop-shaped hive of layered grey paper bands hanging low, small dark entrance hole at the bottom, two tiny wasps near it
